questions.answer: Suction it

questions.stem: In paediatric dental surgery, what is a dental abscess?
questions.answer: Infection at the centre of a tooth spreading to the supporting bone and nearby tissue

questions.answer: Caries

options: Yes, except in the most cooperative older children

questions.stem: Why is good communication with the dentist essential in a paediatric dental abscess?
questions.answer: The anaesthetist cannot reach a partly obstructed airway quickly

questions.stem: What usually happens to swelling and pain after a paediatric dental abscess is treated?
